message.content: The plant can confirm that bench W8 belongs to production lot L9, supported by the production traveller (S2). The claim that only three fittings were torqued before acceptance is contradicted by the torque record (S1), which shows four fittings torqued. The key question is whether bench W8 withstood a 600 N load; the photograph (S3) shows a  600 N setpoint but lacks the serial number and measured load, leaving this claim unresolved. Without conclusive evidence that bench W8 passed the load test, the decision to send it to assembly remains uncertain. Further verification of the load test specific to bench W8 is needed before proceeding.
